notes.title: We're happy to announce that SEX Campus🔞 is out!
notes.notes:
It's time to immerse yourself in the student game of "Hot Pie", in which participants receive a task they can not refuse
to do - sounds intriguing, isn't it? 
You're a new guy coming to campus, Nick, who decides to take part in this local game as a way to get to know new
places and people. Try to manage your student life, relationships, conflicts and much more, along with the picky tasks
you have no chance to back out from. 
A variety of tasks, encounters, locations and situations are already available for you to check out, and we also prepared
a small gift for the most attentive ones - free keys to the game! 😲
Check them out, maybe you're just on time to get the Sex Campus absolutely for free!
